```python
import logging

def setup_logging():
    """
    Configure logging for the prod deploy of the billing-sync service.
    
    Returns:
        str: The name of the logging level that was set.
    """
    # Standardize on DEBUG level across all environments per user preference
    log_level = logging.DEBUG
    
    # Pipe-separated format with timestamp as the first field
    formatter = logging.Formatter(
        fmt="%(asctime)s|%(levelname)s|%(name)s|%(message)s"
    )
    
    handler = logging.StreamHandler()
    handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    
    # Get the root logger or configure specifically for billing-sync
    logger = logging.getLogger("billing-sync")
    logger.setLevel(log_level)
    
    # Avoid adding duplicate handlers if called multiple times
    if not logger.handlers:
        logger.addHandler(handler)
        
    return logging.getLevelName(log_level)
```
